scope: chemoenzymatic photocleavage enrichment and liquid chromatography coupled to mass spectrometry

the fractionated peptides (~300 μg) were dried in vacuum and re-suspended in 1.1 mL of 20 mM HEPES, pH 7.9, and 80 μL of 100 mM MnCl2, 75 μL of 0.5 mM UDP-GalNAz, 62 μL of GalT1 and 2.5 μL of PNGase F (New England Biolabs) were added
the peptides were reacted with 1 mM biotin-PEG-PC-alkyne
